plugins.name: employment-legal
plugins.description: Reviews hires and terminations for jurisdiction-specific risk flags, classifies workers against the controlling state test, tracks leave deadlines before they're missed, runs internal investigations, and drafts policies with state supplements where the law differs.

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Cold-start setup — learns your jurisdictional footprint and escalation rules from your handbook and termination memos. Asks which states and countries have employees, reads seed documents, and builds a jurisdiction-aware escalation table. Use on fresh install, when CLAUDE.md still has [PLACEHOLDER] markers, or when re-running with --redo or --check-integrations.
headings: Check for the shared company profile
After the user picks quick or full
Part 0: Who's using this, and what's connected
skills.description_zh: 依据手册与终止雇佣备忘录初始配置劳动法实践，询问员工所在州与国家，建立对应司法辖区的升级表，也支持重做或检查集成。

skills.name: customize
skills.description: Guided customization of your employment practice profile — change one thing without re-running the whole cold-start interview. Adjust jurisdictional footprint, risk posture, escalation contacts, hiring review rules, termination review rules, handbook positions, investigation preferences, or matter workspace paths. Use when the user says "change my [thing]", "add a jurisdiction", "update my profile", "edit my config", or "customize".
skills.description_zh: 逐项定制劳动法实践档案，调整司法辖区、风险、升级联系人、招聘终止审查、手册立场、调查与工作区，无需重做完整访谈。

skills.name: expansion-kickoff
skills.description: Kick off international expansion planning for a new country — gathers intake, runs EOR vs. entity framing, drafts cross-functional questions, surfaces country-specific flags, and creates a persistent tracker. Use when someone says "we're hiring in [country]", "expansion to [country]", or "first hire in [country]".
skills.description_zh: 为新国家国际招聘启动规划，收集需求、比较名义雇主与设实体、起草跨职能问题、识别国家特殊事项并建立持久跟踪。

skills.name: expansion-update
skills.description: Update the status of an in-progress international expansion project — recalculates what is now unblocked, flags anything overdue, and surfaces the next priorities. Use when work has happened since the last session and the expansion tracker needs to reflect the current state.
skills.description_zh: 更新进行中的国际扩展状态，重新判断已解除阻碍、逾期事项与下一步优先级。

skills.name: handbook-updates
skills.description: Diff a proposed handbook change against the current version, flag ripple effects and state supplement impacts. Use when user says "update the handbook", "add this to the handbook", "handbook change", or has a policy ready for insertion.
headings: What this skill does not do
skills.description_zh: 比较拟议员工手册变化与当前版本，识别连锁影响和各州补充条款变化。

skills.name: hiring-review
skills.description: Review an offer letter and any restrictive covenants — jurisdiction check included. Substantive rules (covenant enforceability, pay-transparency, salary-history limits, exemption criteria) are researched per hire, not stored. Use when the user says "review this offer", "can we use a non-compete here", "check this offer letter", "hiring in [state]", or attaches an offer.
skills.description_zh: 审查录用函与限制性约定，按每次招聘研究司法辖区的竞业、薪酬透明、薪资历史和豁免规则，不沿用存储规则。

skills.name: internal-investigation
skills.description: Reference: shared framework for managing internal investigations from intake through final memo — privileged investigation log, document processing with needle-finding, source coverage tracking, Q&A against the log, memo drafting, and audience summaries. Loaded by /investigation-open, /investigation-add, /investigation-query, /investigation-memo, and /investigation-summary; not invoked directly.

skills.description_zh: 作为内部调查共享框架，管理受特权保护日志、文档重点提取、覆盖跟踪、问答、备忘录和受众摘要，由调查命令加载，不直接调用。

skills.name: international-expansion
skills.description: Reference: implementation-planning framework for international hiring — EOR vs. entity decision framing, cross-functional triggers for tax/finance/HR, structured outside-counsel briefing requests, and a persistent gap tracker. Loaded by /expansion-kickoff and /expansion-update; not invoked directly.
headings: Who needs to be looped in — and what to ask them
What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 作为国际招聘实施规划参考，比较名义雇主与实体、识别税务财务HR事项、准备外部律师简报并维护缺口跟踪，由扩展命令加载。

skills.name: investigation-add
skills.description: Add data to an open investigation — documents, interview notes, or observations. Processes batches against the documented pull criteria, surfaces significant items, and logs everything reviewed for coverage verification. Use when new evidence, interview notes, or document productions come in for an open investigation.
skills.description_zh: 为已开启内部调查加入文档、访谈和观察，按既定提取标准批处理、标出重要事项并记录全部审阅范围。

skills.name: investigation-memo
skills.description: Draft or update the privileged investigation memo from the investigation log. Use when an investigation is far enough along to write the first memo cut, or when new data has been added and the existing draft needs updating.
skills.description_zh: 根据调查日志起草或更新受特权保护的调查备忘录，适用于首次成稿或新证据更新。

skills.name: investigation-open
skills.description: Open a new internal investigation matter — runs intake, generates the sources checklist, and creates the persistent investigation log. Use when a complaint or allegation comes in and the attorney needs to stand up a privileged investigation workspace.
skills.description_zh: 开启内部调查法律事项，收集投诉与指控背景、生成来源清单并建立持久调查日志。

skills.name: investigation-query
skills.description: Ask questions against an open investigation log — what witnesses said, where accounts conflict, what gaps exist, what the strongest evidence is on each issue. Use when the attorney needs to query the investigation record without re-reading every entry.
skills.description_zh: 查询开放调查日志的证词、冲突、缺口及最强证据，帮助律师无需重读全部记录。

skills.name: investigation-summary
skills.description: Draft an audience-specific summary from the privileged investigation memo — HR, leadership, or outside counsel versions. Use when an investigation memo needs to be communicated to an audience that should not see the full privileged work product.
skills.description_zh: 从受特权保护调查备忘录起草HR、管理层或外部律师专用摘要，控制受众所需信息。

skills.name: leave-tracker
skills.description: Check open leaves for deadline alerts and required decisions. Surfaces only the leaves that require an action and explains why — not a status board. Use weekly, or whenever the attorney needs to know which leaves have upcoming designation, certification, or exhaustion deadlines.
skills.description_zh: 检查开放休假中的指定、证明与期满期限，仅列需要采取行动的事项并说明原因，支持每周提醒。

skills.name: log-leave
skills.description: Add a new leave to the leave register with the minimum information needed to start tracking deadlines. Use when an employee goes on leave and you want the tracker to watch designation, certification, and exhaustion clocks from day one.
skills.description_zh: 以最少必要资料把员工新休假加入登记，从第一天跟踪指定、证明与期满时钟。

skills.name: matter-workspace
skills.description: Manage matter workspaces — new, list, switch, close, or detach (practice- level). Creates, lists, switches, closes, and detaches the active matter so context from one client engagement never leaks into another. Use when a multi-client practitioner says "new matter", "switch matter", "list my matters", "close this matter", or needs to manage which matter is active.
headings: Active matter is in the practice CLAUDE.md
skills.description_zh: 管理多客户劳动法事项工作区的创建、列表、切换、关闭或脱离，保持客户上下文隔离。

skills.name: policy-drafting
skills.description: Draft an employment policy with state supplements where law differs across the jurisdictional footprint. Use when the user says "draft a [topic] policy", "we need a policy on", "update our [topic] policy", or names a policy gap.
headings: Drafting Notes (internal — remove before handbook insertion)
skills.description_zh: 起草劳动雇佣政策，并为司法辖区规则差异添加各州补充。

skills.name: termination-review
skills.description: Termination review — high-risk flag detection, severance + release, and final pay timing by jurisdiction. Jurisdiction-specific rules and release consideration periods are researched per review, not stored. Use when the user says "reviewing a termination", "can we fire this person", "term review", or describes a termination scenario.
skills.description_zh: 审查终止雇佣的高风险、遣散与豁免及最终工资时间，每次研究辖区规则和对价期限，不使用存储旧规则。

skills.name: wage-hour-qa
skills.description: Jurisdiction-aware wage/hour and employment Q&A — classification, overtime, meal/rest breaks, leave, final pay — answered for the specific state/country with the controlling rule researched and cited rather than stated from memory. Use when the user asks any employment law question, or says "what's the rule in [state]", "is this exempt", "do we have to pay overtime for", or "can we classify this as".
headings: Step 2: Research the rule, then state it

skills.description_zh: 按具体州或国家研究并引用劳动工资工时规则，回答分类、加班、餐休、休假及最终工资，不凭记忆断言。

skills.name: worker-classification
skills.description: Classify a proposed worker engagement — employee, IC, temp, or vendor — by running the applicable jurisdiction tests and flagging misclassification gaps between the intended arrangement and what the facts actually support. Prospective use only. Use when someone says "we want to bring on a contractor", "is this a vendor or a temp", "how should we classify this person", or describes a proposed working arrangement.
headings: Prospective-only hard gate — run BEFORE intake
Step 3 — Apply the researched tests to the facts
skills.description_zh: 依据适用辖区测试评估拟议员工、独立承包、临时工或供应商安排，指出事实与预期分类的差距，仅用于前瞻方案。
